snippet.title: Shining Soul II (2004) - GBA Longplay | Full Game Walkthrough | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Shining Soul II (2004) for Game Boy Advance - complete full game longplay with no commentary. Watch the entire gameplay walkthrough of this classic handheld action RPG from start to finish.

Originally released in 2004 for the Game Boy Advance, Shining Soul II is an action RPG developed by Grasshopper Manufacture and published by Sega. Choose from multiple character classes including Fighter, Archer, Dragonute, Ninja, Wizard and Priest, explore dangerous dungeons, defeat powerful enemies, collect equipment and uncover the secrets behind the Dark Dragon.

Shining Soul II is part of the legendary Shining series and was released exclusively for the Game Boy Advance.
